title: "Desktop Folder settings" window does not open in maximized state
line: Desktop and widget settings windows that were closed maximized now open maximized again.
explanation: ConfigView saved DialogWidth/DialogHeight on every resize and never saved the window state. When the window is maximized, the resize arrives before the state change, so the screen size was stored as the normal size and the dialog reopened as an unmaximized window as big as the screen. The change saves the size and a DialogMaximized flag when the window closes (size only if it was not maximized), maximizes the window again when it is shown, and on the first unmaximize after that resizes it back to the saved normal size. The restore is done from visibleChanged rather than before show() because plasmashell's show() calls showNormal(), and without a header change so ContainmentConfigView in plasma-workspace needs no rebuild.

commits.message:
configview: remember whether the settings window was maximized

The size was saved on every resize, so a window closed while maximized
came back as a normal window as big as the screen. Save the size and the
maximized state when the window closes and open it maximized again.

BUG: 511082

media.caption: Master: maximized, closed and reopened. It fills the screen but the title bar shows Maximize (^), not Restore.
Fix: same steps, it reopens truly maximized (Restore button).
Master: open Desktop and Wallpaper, maximize, Cancel, reopen, click the title bar button.
Fix: same steps; reopens maximized and Restore brings back the 810x630 window.
Master: clicking the button on the reopened window maximizes it (it wasn't maximized).
Fix: clicking Restore on the reopened window returns it to its previous normal size.

review.text: The diagnosis and overall approach in libplasma ConfigView are on the right track, restoring the maximized state and saving geometry on close without breaking ABI. However, there are two concrete Qt window-state bugs in the patch: the Qt::SingleShotConnection on windowStateChanged disconnects on the first state change even when it is not Qt::WindowNoState (breaking normal-size restore if the dialog is minimized before unmaximizing, or if WindowMaximized arrives asynchronously), and hideEvent() checks windowState() == Qt::WindowMaximized instead of windowStates().testFlag(Qt::WindowMaximized).
changes: Replace the Qt::SingleShotConnection on QWindow::windowStateChanged with state tracked in ConfigViewPrivate (or an explicit QMetaObject::Connection disconnected only inside the state == Qt::WindowNoState branch) so intervening state changes like minimize or an asynchronous WindowMaximized event do not cancel the normal-size restore.

In ConfigView::hideEvent(), use windowStates().testFlag(Qt::WindowMaximized) instead of windowState() == Qt::WindowMaximized so closing a dialog that was minimized while maximized still preserves DialogMaximized and does not overwrite DialogWidth/DialogHeight with maximized dimensions (and also skip saving normal dimensions if Qt::WindowFullScreen is set).

reviews.text: Right layer (libplasma ConfigView, shared by containment and applet settings) and the right cause: DialogWidth/Height were written on every resize, so a maximized close stored the screen size as the normal size and the state was never stored. Saving size + DialogMaximized on hide (size only when not maximized), re-maximizing on show and resizing back to the normal size on the first unmaximize keeps the existing config keys and needs no ABI change; lambdas are scoped to this and the applet is a QPointer, so no lifetime issues. Screenshots and video show the Restore button after reopen and Restore returning to the saved 810x630; the trade-off of saving only on close (like KWindowConfig) is stated in notes. Commit message and explanation match the diff.
